beginner.title: Tabata Foundation

structure.format: Tabata — 20s work / 10s rest × 8 rounds per station

beginner.scaling: Step jacks instead of jumping, knee push-ups, reduce squat depth
beginner.coaching_cue: Push the 20s — the 10s is yours, not a head start on the next round.

beginner.title: Run The Clock
beginner.scaling: Replace sprint with brisk walk, reduce rounds to 5
beginner.coaching_cue: Sprint pace should be uncomfortable, not unsustainable — find the edge and hold it.

beginner.title: The 12
beginner.scaling: 8 squats + 2 burpees, knee push-ups, reduce sit-up to crunch
beginner.coaching_cue: Finish each minute with at least 10 seconds spare — if you can't, reduce the reps now.

beginner.title: Step Up
beginner.scaling: Air squat instead of jump squat, march in place instead of high knees
beginner.coaching_cue: Land every jump squat softly — flat-foot landings send the impact straight to your knees.

beginner.title: Short Ladder
beginner.scaling: Step burpee, air squat instead of squat jump, cap at rung 3 if needed
beginner.coaching_cue: Breathe at the top of every burpee — it costs one second and saves the entire set.

beginner.title: Station Break
beginner.scaling: Knee push-up, reduce step height, plank instead of hollow body
beginner.coaching_cue: Every station is a clean start — reset your breathing between stations, not mid-exercise.

beginner.title: Double AMRAP

structure.goal: Match or beat AMRAP 10 round count in AMRAP 5

beginner.scaling: Step jacks, knee push-ups, squat pulse instead of hop
beginner.coaching_cue: Track your round count in AMRAP 10 — the AMRAP 5 score tells you how well you paced.

beginner.title: Effort Ladder
equipment: none — outdoor, treadmill, or open space
beginner.scaling: 7/10 = brisk walk, 9/10 = fastest walk possible, reduce to 4 rounds
beginner.coaching_cue: 9/10 effort is the fastest you can sustain for 60 seconds — not a 5-second sprint.

beginner.title: Push–Pull Tabata Pairs

structure.format: Tabata pairs — 20s on / 10s off × 8 rounds per pair

pairs.format: Alternate exercises each round × 8 total rounds
Alternate exercises each round × 8 total rounds

beginner.scaling: Knee push-up, bench dip, static lunge
beginner.coaching_cue: In Tabata, consistent reps across all 8 rounds beats blowing up in round 1 — start at 70%.

beginner.title: Breathless 15

structure.rest: Only when needed — rest as little as possible

beginner.scaling: Start at 12-9-6-4-2, knee push-ups
beginner.coaching_cue: Breathe between movements, not mid-rep — broken rhythm costs more time than a 10-second breath.

intermediate.title: Tabata Complex
intermediate.format: Tabata — 20s work / 10s rest × 8 rounds per station, 3 stations
intermediate.scaling: Lighter KB, step-up box, rower or ski erg instead of bike
intermediate.coaching_cue: KB swing: hips snap, arms follow — pulling with your arms kills the power before it starts.

intermediate.title: Fight Gone Bad
intermediate.format: 3 rounds × 5 stations × 1 min each, 1 min rest between rounds

structure.score: total reps + calories across all rounds

intermediate.scaling: Lighter loads, step-ups, DB push press
intermediate.coaching_cue: Rotate stations with zero dead time — the 1-min rest is the only full stop you get.

intermediate.title: KB Gauntlet
intermediate.scaling: Lighter KB, two-hand clean, step hop
intermediate.coaching_cue: Goblet squat: elbows inside knees, chest tall — the KB will pull you forward if your brace fails.

intermediate.title: Bike Pyramid
intermediate.format: 3 rounds of ascending/descending max effort intervals
intermediate.coaching_cue: The first 3 seconds of each max effort establish your power — don't ramp, explode from zero.

intermediate.title: Engine Test

structure.note: Reduce target if less than 10s rest remains in any minute

intermediate.scaling: 10 cal row, step-overs instead of jump-overs
intermediate.coaching_cue: You should finish each minute with 8–10s spare — if you don't, drop the target by 2 immediately.

intermediate.title: Threshold Intervals
intermediate.format: 5 rounds of sustained effort / active recovery
intermediate.scaling: 3 min at 7/10 RPE / 3 min easy, 4 rounds
intermediate.coaching_cue: 8/10 effort means you can say one word but not a sentence — find that line and live there for 4 minutes.

intermediate.title: KB Total

exercises.name: KB Clean and Press — each arm (20/16 kg)

intermediate.scaling: Lighter KB, two-hand swing, separate clean and press
intermediate.coaching_cue: Clean-and-press: the press is strict — zero leg drive. If you push-press it, the clean weight is too heavy.

intermediate.title: Row and Burn
intermediate.coaching_cue: Row: legs drive first, arms follow — pulling with your back before your legs extend loses 20% of every stroke.

intermediate.format: 4 rounds of 3-movement sprint complex with full rest
intermediate.scaling: Rower instead of bike, step-overs, reduce to 3 rounds
intermediate.coaching_cue: The 20s rest is not passive — controlled breathing only. Flopping on the floor costs the next round.

intermediate.title: Run and Pull Chipper
intermediate.scaling: Banded pull-ups or ring rows, halve run distances
intermediate.coaching_cue: Break pull-ups into small sets from rep one — 5s of rest between sets costs nothing; sets of 1 after failure costs everything.

beginner.title: First 25

structure.rule: Maintain a pace where you can speak in full sentences without pausing to breathe

beginner.scaling: Walk the full 25 min; introduce 30s jogs every 3 min once breathing stays easy
beginner.coaching_cue: If you have to open your mouth to breathe, you are already out of zone 2 — slow down.

beginner.title: Flat Bike Hold
beginner.format: Continuous stationary bike at fixed resistance

structure.rule: If cadence drops below 70 RPM, reduce resistance instead of grinding

beginner.scaling: Reduce to 15-min zone 2 block; extend by 5 min per session over 4 weeks
beginner.coaching_cue: Cadence over resistance — spinning at 85 RPM is aerobic work; grinding at 60 RPM is not.

beginner.title: Easy Row

focus_cues: Legs drive first — feel the hamstrings load before the arms begin to pull
Full slide on recovery — don't rush the return

beginner.scaling: 15 min with a 30s standing rest every 5 min; progress to continuous over 2 weeks
beginner.coaching_cue: At zone 2 pace, your catch angle and finish position should be clean every stroke — if they're not, you've gone too fast.

beginner.title: Walk-to-Jog Builder
beginner.format: Progressive run/walk intervals building toward continuous jog

structure.rule: Jog pace must allow nasal breathing throughout — mouth breathing = too fast

beginner.scaling: Replace jog with brisk walk and walk with slow walk; same time structure
beginner.coaching_cue: Each jog interval ends before you are breathing hard — that restraint is exactly what builds your aerobic base.

beginner.title: Incline Walk
beginner.format: Sustained incline treadmill walk at fixed pace

structure.hr_check: every 10 min — reduce incline 1% if HR exceeds 70% max

beginner.scaling: 4% incline for 20 min; increase incline by 1% per session
beginner.coaching_cue: Hold the handrails only for balance, not for support — offloading your bodyweight removes the aerobic stimulus entirely.

beginner.title: Nasal Breathing Run
beginner.format: Continuous run gated by breathing quality

structure.rule: Nose-breathe exclusively — the moment you need to open your mouth, reduce pace until nasal breathing is restored
structure.expected_pace: likely 30–90s per km slower than normal easy pace

beginner.scaling: Walk with nasal breathing if pace drops to near-walk — the constraint is the session, not the speed
beginner.coaching_cue: This will feel embarrassingly slow the first time — that gap between your current pace and your aerobic capacity is exactly what you're here to close.

beginner.title: 3-Phase Aerobic Build
beginner.format: Single continuous session divided into 3 ascending RPE thirds

structure.modality: Run, bike, or row — your choice, keep it consistent

equipment: none, stationary bike, or rowing ergometer
beginner.scaling: Shorten each phase to 7 min (21 min total); reduce Phase 3 RPE to 4/10
beginner.coaching_cue: Phase 3 at 5/10 RPE should still allow full sentences — if you're cutting words, dial it back.

beginner.title: Row–Walk Alternation
beginner.format: Cross-modality aerobic session — alternating rowing erg and brisk walk
beginner.scaling: 3 rounds (30 min total); reduce row to 3 min if stroke mechanics break down
beginner.coaching_cue: The walk after rowing lets your HR settle while staying aerobically active — don't sit down between blocks.

beginner.title: Steady Bike — Perceived Effort Lock
beginner.format: Continuous bike session with mid-session RPE self-assessment

check_points.action: Speak 10 words aloud — adjust resistance if breathless
Speak 10 words aloud — if still easy, increase cadence by 5 RPM

structure.rule: No HR monitor required — effort perception is the training tool here

beginner.scaling: 20 min total, single check-point at 10 min
beginner.coaching_cue: Talking aloud to yourself is not optional here — it's the only accurate zone 2 gauge you have without a heart rate monitor.

beginner.title: Long Walk with Intention
beginner.format: Power walk — structured pacing with arm drive

structure.speed: 5–6 km/h on flat or 4–5 km/h on 4% incline
technique_cues: Strong arm drive — elbows at 90°, forward-back motion
Heel strike to toe push-off — full stride length

beginner.scaling: 30 min flat walk; add incline or time as fitness builds
beginner.coaching_cue: A power walk at 6 km/h with full arm drive is a legitimate aerobic training session — do not underestimate it.
